svg.title: ClusterLab: shapes first, labels later
svg.desc: Ten learned raw-pixel k-means++ centers, all four held-out score rows and a local-minimum counterexample. Cluster IDs are not digit predictions.
svg.text: 3,823 fitting digits. 1,797 untouched test digits. No labels used to fit or choose a restart.
Ten learned raw-pixel means / k-means++ seed 107 / arbitrary cluster indices
Frozen official test audit / k = 10 / ten starts per arm
* PCA and whitening change the metric. Inertia/silhouette are not a cross-geometry ranking.
ARI/NMI use labels only after fitting. NMI is not chance-adjusted. Scores are not classifier accuracy.
Descent is not global optimality: [0, 1, 4, 5, 9, 10], k=2, starts [0, 1] -> 26.5.
All 31 nonempty binary partitions give global optimum 17.5. No global certificate for real-data fits.
Alpaydin & Kaynak (1998), UCI Optical Digits, CC BY 4.0. Code MIT. Fixed-seed descriptive audit; no endorsement.
